testSuite.details: Full suite: python3 -m pytest tests/ -q -> 1333 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped in 48.93s (expected 1333 per audit-fix baseline ed10c58). Focused feature files (test_pending_articles_repo.py, test_admin_alerts.py, test_admin_ping.py, test_integration.py) -> 228 passed. Watch item test_main_wires_review_listener (flaked once in a subset run during audit verification) PASSED in this full run - no re-run needed. Smoke checks from tasks 1/2/5 re-run green: task-1 token round-trip on temp DB -> ok; task-2 keyboard callback_data ['dd:c:t','dd:k:t'] -> ok; task-5 hasattr(news_bot,'_run_review_listener') -> True.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Под [E014] «Похож на дубль» — ровно две кнопки «🚫 Не публиковать» / «👍 Оставить»; под другими алертами (E006/E008/E009/E015/E034…) кнопок нет
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_admin_alerts.py::TestDedupReviewKeyboard::{test_two_buttons_callback_data,test_button_labels} (exactly two buttons, exact labels); tests/test_integration.py::TestDedupReviewButtons::test_flag_on_e014_send_includes_review_keyboard (real job() run, E014 carries the keyboard); ::test_only_e014_carries_keyboard (mixed E014+E015 run: E015 provably fired and it plus every other admin ping has no reply_markup — non-vacuous control). Builder: admin_alerts.py:754-770.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: «Не публиковать» до слота убирает статью из pending_articles — в свой слот она в канал не выходит
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_integration.py::TestResolveDedupCallback::test_cancel_pending_row_skips_and_returns_cancelled (real tempfile SQLite: row deleted from pending_articles, present in processed_news) and ::test_cancel_then_slot_publish_does_not_publish (after cancel, slot publish drive: cancelled link never handed to _fallback_publish, absent from list_pending()/published_articles).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: После «Не публиковать» кнопки заменяются на «✅ Отменено оператором»; повторно нажать нельзя (клавиатура снята)
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Logic fully autotested: tests/test_integration.py::TestReviewListener::test_review_listener_dispatches_admin_cancel (edit_message_text called with original text + '✅ Отменено оператором' appended and reply_markup=None — keyboard dropped; answer_callback_query sent); TestResolveDedupCallback::test_stale_token_returns_expired (second press of a consumed button → «⚠️ Кнопка устарела», no crash). Visual in-chat confirmation deferred to Task 12 (see deferredToPostDeploy).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: «Оставить» не отменяет публикацию; кнопки заменяются на «👍 Оставлено»
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_integration.py::TestResolveDedupCallback::test_keep_returns_kept_no_state_change (status «👍 Оставлено», pending row untouched, no publish cancellation); listener applies the same edit-with-status/drop-keyboard path proven in test_review_listener_dispatches_admin_cancel. Visual in-chat confirmation deferred to Task 12.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: «Не публиковать» после публикации → «⚠️ Уже опубликовано, отменить нельзя», пост в канале остаётся
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_integration.py::TestResolveDedupCallback::test_cancel_published_returns_already_published (published_articles row intact after press) and ::test_cancel_race_published_between_check_and_skip (row published between get_pending check and skip_pending → honest «уже опубликовано», not «отменено»). Visual in-chat confirmation deferred to Task 12.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Повторное/устаревшее нажатие (уже отменили/опубликовали, рестарт и строки нет) не приводит к ошибке — понятный статус, бот не падает
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_integration.py::TestResolveDedupCallback::test_stale_token_returns_expired («⚠️ Кнопка устарела»), ::test_cancel_missing_returns_unavailable («⚠️ Статья уже недоступна»), ::test_unknown_action_safe_fallback_token_not_consumed (garbage actions safe, token kept); TestReviewListener::test_review_listener_handler_error_advances_offset_and_survives (poisoned update logged, offset acked, thread survives).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Кнопки действуют только для администратора (from_user.id vs числовой TELEGRAM_ADMIN_ID); чужие нажатия игнорируются, очередь не меняется
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_integration.py::TestResolveDedupCallback::test_non_admin_press_ignored_no_state_change (queue untouched, (None,'') returned) and ::test_non_numeric_admin_id_fail_closed (non-numeric admin id → nobody authorized); TestReviewListener::test_ignored_press_answers_empty_and_never_edits (non-admin: empty answer only, no edit, ZERO DB reads — get_review_token_link not-called spy). Gate: news_bot._is_admin_press (news_bot.py:559-579), applied before any DB read (news_bot.py:806).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: «Слушание» включено только на прод-инстансе; тест не обслуживает кнопки (общий токен)
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: The live property (only the prod instance polls; the test instance serves no presses; no 409 Conflict between real instances) requires two live deployments on the shared bot token — cannot be verified pre-deploy. The gate LOGIC that implements it is autotested green under T7 (flag off / non-numeric admin / empty token → no thread; default off). Deferred to post-deploy Task 12 per task plan.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Приём нажатий работает параллельно с отбором/публикацией по слотам и не ломает/не задерживает публикации
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_pending_articles_repo.py::TestConcurrentWriters::test_two_writers_no_database_locked (genuinely contended two-writer test, threading.Event-synced while the write lock is provably held — no 'database is locked'); tests/test_integration.py::TestInFlightCancelGuard::{test_cancel_mid_publish_aborts_before_teaser,test_publish_proceeds_when_row_still_pending} (cancel racing an in-flight publish resolves safely both ways); TestReviewListener::test_review_listener_error_does_not_propagate (listener failure never reaches the publish loop). Listener is a daemon thread with per-thread SQLite connections (news_bot.py:1027-1032, pending_articles_repo._connect).

Store: pending_articles_repo.py:1092-1144 over the existing bot_state table.

Auth gate runs FIRST (news_bot.py:626-629).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Отмена до слота удаляет строку из pending_articles → не публикуется; отмена после публикации → «уже опубликовано», published-строка цела
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_integration.py::TestResolveDedupCallback::test_cancel_then_slot_publish_does_not_publish and ::test_cancel_published_returns_already_published (published row intact). Strengthened in-flight coverage (audit CA-1, current spec text): TestInFlightCancelGuard::test_cancel_mid_publish_aborts_before_teaser (pre-teaser re-check at news_bot.py:2340-2346 aborts as success-without-publish) and tests/test_pending_articles_repo.py::TestMoves::{test_move_to_published_missing_row_warns_and_dozapis_published,test_move_to_published_missing_row_no_processed_news_uses_link} (CA-1b: move_to_published WARN+dozapis instead of silent no-op).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: _connect() ставит busy_timeout; тест конкурентной записи не даёт database is locked
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_pending_articles_repo.py::TestConnectBusyTimeout::test_connect_sets_busy_timeout (PRAGMA busy_timeout reads 5000) and ::test_connect_passes_explicit_timeout_parameter (call-spy pins timeout=5.0, verified to fail on revert); TestConcurrentWriters::test_two_writers_no_database_locked (Event-synced contention while the lock is held) plus negative control ::test_zero_timeout_control_raises_database_locked. Mechanism note (Task 1 decision): connect-param sqlite3.connect(..., timeout=5.0) — equivalent to PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000 without an extra execute() (pending_articles_repo.py:182-197).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Listener стартует только при REVIEW_BUTTONS_ENABLED И числовом admin id; иначе потока нет (fail-closed)
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_integration.py::TestReviewListener::{test_review_listener_starts_when_enabled_and_numeric_admin,test_review_listener_not_started_when_flag_off,test_review_listener_not_started_when_admin_non_numeric,test_review_listener_not_started_when_bot_token_missing} (gate strengthened by audit CA-3 to include empty TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN — matches current spec text); tests/test_job_distributed_publish.py::test_main_wires_review_listener (mutation-verified pin that main() actually calls _maybe_start_review_listener, news_bot.py:3377). Gate: _review_listener_gate_reason() news_bot.py:935-963. Runtime 'review listener active' line in docker logs → deferred to Task 12.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Ошибка в listener никогда не прерывает публикационный цикл
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_integration.py::TestReviewListener::test_review_listener_error_does_not_propagate (poll failure → backoff-pinned sleep spy, no propagation), ::test_review_listener_handler_error_advances_offset_and_survives (poisoned update logged and skipped), ::test_review_listener_conflict_409_logged_with_backoff (409 → explicit single-listener ERROR + 60s backoff). Three-layer isolation: per-update try/except, poll-cycle try/except with backoff, belt-and-braces outer handler; daemon=True thread (news_bot.py:879-932, 1027-1031).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Каждое терминальное нажатие логирует решение оператора (cancel/keep + link + статус) на уровне INFO
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_integration.py::TestReviewListener::test_decision_logged_even_when_edit_fails (assertLogs('news_bot', level='INFO'): exactly one 'operator decision' line with action+link+status, emitted BEFORE Telegram I/O so a failing edit does not cost the audit line — audit CA-2) and ::test_review_listener_dispatches_admin_cancel. Log site: news_bot.py:833-836 (no token value — log hygiene).

coverageVerification.edgeCases: All mandatory edge cases have tests: stale/unknown token (test_stale_token_returns_expired), non-admin press (test_non_admin_press_ignored_no_state_change + zero-DB-read listener spy), slot-boundary race (test_cancel_race_published_between_check_and_skip + TestInFlightCancelGuard), database-is-locked (test_two_writers_no_database_locked + zero-timeout negative control), fail-closed gate (3 not-started tests + bot-token variant), listener crash isolation (3 tests).
coverageVerification.behavioralDepth: Tests exercise real behavior, not imports/mocks-only: TestResolveDedupCallback and TestReviewListener dispatch tests run against real tempfile SQLite with seeded rows; TestDedupReviewButtons drives the real job(); decision-log test asserts INFO records via assertLogs; multiple assertions are mutation-verified per decisions.md (wiring pin, backoff spies, token-before-send ordering, gate guards).
